Her name, लक्ष्मी (Lakshmi), is derived from the Sanskrit word लक्ष्मा (lakṣmā), which means 'the one who brings wealth.' It is often used as a female given name in Hindu culture as a prayer for abundance and good fortune.
data.spiritual_significance: Lakshmi represents the divine feminine, Venus, and is the embodiment of wealth, luxury, and beauty. She is also known as Mahalakshmi or the great goddess of wealth and is often invoked for material success and growth.
